name: B10-0344/2025 (Renew) – Urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the Syrian authorities to investigate attacks on religious and ethnic groups, punish those responsible and remove officials involved. It wants the EU to set up a fund for rebuilding Syria, but only if real progress is made on justice and inclusive government. It also calls for better protection of places of worship, restoration of the Mar Elias church, and an end to foreign military interference in Syria.

- The EU would tie a new Syria Reconstruction Fund to progress on justice and inclusive government.
- Syria's government is asked to investigate attacks, prosecute those responsible and protect worship sites.
- The EU and others are urged to keep fighting terrorism and to press Israel and Türkiye to stop interfering.
